title: Partners
description: Trusted design partners contribute branded, benchmarked, production-ready edge AI content for Infineon hardware.
long_description: The DEEPCRAFT™ AI Hub brings together Infineon content and contributions from trusted design partners. Partner projects are published with partner branding, benchmark data, and deployment resources so you can evaluate and integrate third-party edge AI solutions on Infineon hardware. Partner entries are identified by the partner logo and website link in each project's metadata. Browse partner content to find models and solutions optimized for Infineon platforms by ecosystem experts who bring specialized domain knowledge, deployment experience, and production-ready implementations.

boxes.heading: Become a Partner
boxes.text: Infineon welcomes design partners and ecosystem contributors who have deployable edge AI content for PSOC™ and other open Infineon platforms. Approved submissions are published on the DEEPCRAFT™ AI Hub after review.

boxes.heading: What You Can Contribute
boxes.text: Choose the repository that matches your content type:

steps.text: DEEPCRAFT™ Studio starter projects with sample data and a project file (.improj) for classification, regression, or object detection workflows.
Deployable models with pre-built firmware (.hex), embedded artifacts (fw/), documentation, and benchmarks for PSOC™ Edge and PSOC™ 6.

The Model Zoo for AURIX is maintained by Infineon Automotive and is not open for general partner or community submissions for now. See the README and contribution guidelines in the corresponding repository for details on how to contribute.

boxes.heading: Get in Touch
boxes.text: Interested in becoming a partner or publishing your first project? Reach out to Infineon when you open your pull request, or contact us through Infineon DEEPCRAFT™ Edge AI Solutions to discuss your content before submitting.
